objective: Compute SAIDI and CAIDI impact of a deployed FCI set.

title.en: REL-TASK-053 — SAIDI/CAIDI impact of FCI deployment
title.ru: REL-TASK-053 — Влияние внедрения FCI на SAIDI/CAIDI

objective.en: Calculate reliability indices before and after FCI-based restoration-time reductions.
objective.ru: Рассчитать показатели надёжности до и после сокращения времени восстановления за счёт FCI.

instructions.en: Use fci_reliability_case. Compute baseline SAIDI, CAIDI, and SAIFI from section fault rates, interrupted customers, and restoration durations. Then apply deployed FCI restoration-time reductions with the minimum restoration-time floor and report baseline, with_fci, and improvements.
instructions.ru: Используйте fci_reliability_case. Рассчитайте базовые SAIDI, CAIDI и SAIFI по интенсивностям повреждений участков, числу отключаемых потребителей и длительностям восстановления. Затем примените сокращения времени восстановления от установленных FCI с нижним пределом времени восстановления и укажите baseline, with_fci и improvements.

public_inputs.calculation_spec: Baseline customer-minutes/year = sum(annual_fault_rate * customers_interrupted * base_restoration_minutes). With FCI, reduce each section duration by the best reduction from deployed FCI locations, bounded below by minimum_restoration_minutes. SAIDI = customer-minutes / total_customers. CAIDI = customer-minutes / customer-interruptions. SAIFI = customer-interruptions / total_customers.

submission_schema.baseline: object with exactly these keys: saidi_min_per_customer_year, caidi_min_per_interruption, saifi_interruptions_per_customer_year
submission_schema.with_fci: object with exactly these keys: saidi_min_per_customer_year, caidi_min_per_interruption, saifi_interruptions_per_customer_year (after FCI reductions)

hard_constraints: Reliability indices must match the public definitions and inputs.
FCI restoration reductions must respect the minimum restoration-time floor.
Unknown extra answer keys are infeasible.

metrics.name: feasible
metrics.description: Whether submitted reliability indices satisfy all hard constraints.

source_provenance.title: Brown, Faulted Circuit Indicators and System Reliability
source_provenance.notes: Grounds reliability-index effects of FCI deployment; the case computes SAIDI/CAIDI changes deterministically.
